readerCopy.body: A difficult experience can become easier to understand once it no longer has to be forced into one definitive explanation. When Neptune trines Chiron, imagination and sensitivity reinforce each other, allowing grief, memory, art, or an unresolved ending to be held with more complexity. Distance can reveal more than the version repeated immediately after the event. Meaning is allowed to change even when the facts stay the same.
